casting.why: The opening directly states the protagonist is Tomas, the night bus driver from the story bible, and the narrative matches his experience.

designs.Tomas: Caucasian man, 52-56, slim-athletic build, tired oval face with prominent nose bridge. Short, thinning grey-peppered hair, always slightly uncombed. Wears the same worn navy polyester-cotton bus driver's jacket with faded silver reflective stripes over a grey crewneck t-shirt. Always wears a simple gold wedding band. Grey stubble, heavy-lidded blue eyes with deep creases at the corners.
designs.The Woman in Yellow: Any race, female, late 20s to 30s, gaunt and thin build. Face forever obscured by the deep shadow of a soaked yellow PVC raincoat hood. Only her pale hands are ever visible, slender with short, clean nails. The hooded raincoat, a specific flat lemon-yellow, is always dripping, worn directly over bare skin or simple garments. Never seen without it; her posture is perpetually hunched and still.
designs.The Storyteller: a tall, gaunt man of indeterminate age in a long, worn charcoal coat and a wide-brimmed hat, his face mostly in shadow except for pale, kind, tired eyes; he always carries an old iron lantern whose flame burns blood red
